environment.description: Linux; final frozen CW-10 candidate; worker plus independent public-response/contract tests; real Git worktree and host-shell fixtures

items.evidence: The 44-test runtime uses real Git repositories and detached worktrees to verify full explicit commit OIDs, canonical external empty targets, exact cwd/HEAD, preserved dirty and untracked source state, retained worktrees, and fail-closed manager reporting for invalid commit/target/preparation without development-directory fallback. The actual OMP run independently verified the prepared commit and retained worktree.

Real Git runtime tests verify the workflow only prepares a detached worktree from the manager-supplied local commit and never invokes commit, push, merge, stash, reset, or clean; unrelated dirty/untracked source files remain preserved. WORKTREE-GUIDE assigns selective local commit preparation to Manager and explicitly excludes push/merge authority.
